References and scope

Primary sources consulted on 2026-10-08. External links are explicit; they load no resource automatically.

Git worktree

Classification: tool-reference. Git worktree.

Separate working trees share repository objects and refs; they are not a security sandbox.

Git merge-base

Classification: tool-reference. Git merge-base.

--is-ancestor distinguishes ancestry, with exit 1 for false and other errors handled separately.
